card.name: Letter D inside abbreviations and names
card.fires_on: The letters AD, d or D (or is, -d) when they sit inside a capitalised abbreviation, regimen code, or foreign proper name. Examples are NLAD, Vd, Vdss and VLADNIC.

modes.description: A D or AD ending or sitting inside an all-caps or mixed-case abbreviation such as a device name or regimen.

modes.label: Pieces of proper names
